title: Case #4 — Redshifted radio galaxies · Arp 299, 1.35 GHz (Band 2), z = 2.00
description: SKA-Mid AA* observation of the Arp 299 continuum model rescaled from z = 0.0109 to z = 2.00 in Band 2: 1.31 GHz centre, 720 MHz in 64 channels, 600 s around transit. WSClean multiscale imaging at Briggs robust -2, 2048 x 2048 pixels over 72 arcsec, 10000 iterations with mgain 0.5. One of 18 Arp 299 runs (native redshift and z = 0.15–2.00, in Bands 2, 5a and 5b) behind the redshift sequence.
